There is a vertically placed yellow-black striped bar positioned at the right, however it is touching the left side of the vertical bar, and not under it.

Screen capture of two simulated devices in Device Hub.

At the top and iPhone 18 Pro in landscape, and below it an iPhone Duo open, also in landscape.

Both have safari open on localhost where a page is displaying a "viewport-fit=cover" Safe-area edge test page.

There is a vertically placed yellow-black striped bar positioned at the right on both. On the first iPhone it is touching the right side of the screen, and a right: env() div is correctly placed inside the safe area.

On the second iPhone, the bar is also touching the side, but the right safe area is 0.

record.text:
The new iPhone Duo (at time of filming) doesn't seem to have any support for viewport-fit=cover, preventing anything from appearing below the vertical bar.

Please let this be a bug, and not yet another set of APIs we need to adhere. env(), safe-inset, viewport-fit=cover should just work.
